properties.displayName: SCF - Manual attestation for enforcing Application Control to Block Unauthorised or Unknown Executables
properties.description: This policy requires manual attestation to confirm the enforcement of measures to block unauthorized or unknown applications from executing attacks like ransomware by enforcing restrictive applications controls.
